_comment: TEMPLATE for data/refresh.config.json (which is gitignored — server-owned so the settings dashboard's runtime edits never collide with git pulls). Edit this via the Settings page (writes the config + restarts the loop live) — no need to hand-edit the file. lib/refresh.mjs seeds refresh.config.json from this file on boot if it's missing; a missing file also falls back to DEFAULT_CONFIG. In-process refresh of BAKED data catalogs: riftbound.json + riftbound-prices.json (keyless TCGplayer market prices — the tracker's ONLY Riftbound price source now that Scrydex is 402 SUBSCRIPTION_INACTIVE, so dropping this bake stops price_snapshots accruing) + pokemon-intl-sets.json (JP/CN/KO from TCGdex) + pokemon-en-early.json (early EN from PriceCharting) + pokemon-mep.json (Mega Evolution Promo from TCGplayer). ORDER MATTERS where a bake reads another's output: riftbound before riftbound-prices, pokemon-en-early and pokemon-set-symbols after pokemon-intl, and pokemon-coverage after both Pokemon set bakes (it proves what they produced). pokemon-coverage is the watchdog: it resolves every recently-released set through the real source chain and alerts on any that returns zero cards - freshness alone cannot tell you a SET is missing. catalog-cards goes last (slow, throttled). The valid bake names are whatever lib/refresh.mjs BAKES registers (see availableBakes()).
